guide: docs/test-writing-guide.md: Pre-Submit Checklist and Red Flags
method: All Task3 changed source diffs/new source, deadline/store/trail/API/public tests, collector helpers/five cases/coverage/operator instructions and full named reports reviewed as one coverage set. Existing Task1/2 owners preserved and independently hash-bound; no claim of a fresh manual review of every unchanged test.

findings.issue: Store COMMIT-response phase test alone did not execute public recovery advice.
findings.resolution: External store_test public Decide/GetPermission composition reuses internal Store test-only real SQLite driver boundary; no production seam. Real COMMIT succeeds then response expires, actual classifier returns ErrInternal and exact inspection phrase, fresh independent public reader sees allow, two reads preserve facts, exactly one verdict UPDATE/COMMIT. Distinct API recovery boundary complements SQL phase owner.

mandatory_unresolved.observed: After child CLI exit, audit file does not exist. Original envelope, 300ms+1s+startup bound and no-decision checks reported no failure before audit read.
mandatory_unresolved.assessment: Source lifecycle/contract finding requiring Engineer assessment: Client.Decide deferred trail.Emit uses expired original ctx and can return ErrPending immediately after queue admission. CLI main os.Exit(run()) ends the worker; deferred Client.Close only closes Store, no trail drain is wired. This is not an in-process observer that test polling can synchronize after child exit. Do not weaken exactly-one audit assertion or extend operation budget; phase scheduling is not established by receipt.

mandatory_unresolved.observed: Fresh same-call-after-release expected success, received store: commit outcome unconfirmed wrapping context deadline exceeded.
mandatory_unresolved.assessment: Fresh source/test contract assessment required. A released connection alone cannot promise real SQL and COMMIT finish inside a fixed budget, but receipt does not establish whether this is fixture assumption or source defect. Preserve uncertainty and all original bounds/parallelism; do not change source or rerun unchanged.

checklist.parameterization: Five SQL phases, three setup errors, four callers, three controls and four representative faults parameterized. All new Go files below 500 lines; existing larger files already feature grouped/parameterized.
checklist.fixtures: Existing relayEnv/parked decorator, apitest.SeedDecideFixtureAgent/procfix, deadlineBoundary/execHookConnector, cursorfix/newCursorPaneScenario/public adapter/owned-launch/sql reused. No copied controller/retry/queue implementation, helper-only tests, parallel exhaustive fault matrix, or newly unused helper found.
checklist.isolation: Per-test real SQLite; test singleton holders serial with reasons; public fixtures serial for HOME/PATH/tmux environment; independent tests parallel. Bun execution remains sequential. Finite contexts/event channels/process waits and owned cleanup retained.
checklist.preservation: Entry manifest binds all unchanged guards: Task1 R1-R5/E2 bounded pending/hash/dialog/answer gates, frame/request minima, postwait authority, independent permission/plan/unknown holds, question denial, ack before bytes and native pause/exact owned death. No deadline/SQL timeout/assertion relaxation, parallelism reduction, retry-until-green, or concurrent send atomicity promise.
checklist.evidence: Received raw bytes versus complete frames and source-derived versus received traffic are distinct; P1 startup/P2 completed publication/P3 partial-byte corrections reviewed. No audit fsync/crash durability claim; cleanup quarantines leases and original deadline/one-second zero-work semantics agree with docs. Native uninterruptible/descheduling limits remain explicit.
checklist.formal: No actual spec/tla input change; zero formal/parser/TLC/Java jobs.
